author: gpt
statement: For every n>=1 the nearest-integer rounded twelve-block coloring (ties up) has count 117 n²/2192−n/2 plus a function of n mod 1096, whose exact extrema are −369/548 and 1453/137. This gives V(n)<=117 n²/2192−n/2+1453/137 at every length.
falsifier: An exact count with a different excess on the same residue, an omitted affine branch or wrong quarter-cell correction, or a residue outside the two extrema.
